---
title: "Sturgeon/nanopore molecular report"
subtitle: "Pipeline version: `r params$version` | Run date: `r params$rundate` | Sample ID: `r params$sample`"
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
    keep_tex: true
params:
  sample: "SAMPLE_NAME"
  version: "VERSION_PLACEHOLDER"
  rundate: "RUN_DATE_PLACEHOLDER"
  knit_root_dir: '.'
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
```
# Sturgeon V1 classification
```{r sturgeon_plot}
sturgeon_plot_path <- file.path("results", params$sample, "merged_probes_methyl_calls_general.pdf")
if (file.exists(sturgeon_plot_path)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath(sturgeon_plot_path, mustWork = TRUE), rel_path = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("Sturgeon classification plot not found.")
}
```

# Sturgeon V2 classification
```{r sturgeon_v2_plot, out.width='100%', fig.align='center'}
sturgeon_v2_plot_path <- file.path("results", params$sample, "sturgeon_v2_outcome.png")

if (file.exists(sturgeon_v2_plot_path)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath(sturgeon_v2_plot_path, mustWork = TRUE), rel_path = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("Sturgeon v2 classification plot not found.")
}
```

\newpage
# MGMT Promoter Methylation
```{r MGMT}
mgmt_path <- file.path("results", params$sample, "MGMT_analysis", "mgmt_prediction.tsv")
if (file.exists(mgmt_path)) {
  mgmt <- read_tsv(mgmt_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  kable(mgmt, caption = "MGMT Promoter Methylation Score")
} else {
  cat("MGMT methylation prediction not found.")
}
```

\newpage
# CNV Profile
```{r CNV, out.width='90%', fig.align='center'}
cnv_path <- file.path("results", params$sample, "QDNAseq_ACE", paste0(params$sample, "_CNV.png"))
if (file.exists(cnv_path)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath(cnv_path, mustWork = TRUE), rel_path = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("CNV profile not found.")
}
```

# ACE Tumor Purity & Ploidy
```{r ACE}
ace_path <- file.path("results", params$sample, "QDNAseq_ACE", "ACE_summary.tsv")
if (file.exists(ace_path)) {
  ace <- read_tsv(ace_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  kable(ace, caption = "Tumor Purity and Ploidy Estimates from ACE")
} else {
  cat("ACE estimate not found.")
}
```
